title: Guy Ends Deputy's Career with One Crazy Move
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On June 15, 2021, Deputy Sheriff Eric Tollackson with the Vernon County Sheriff's Office was dispatched to a residence for an unstable male in La Farge, WI. Upon arrival, the male immediately sprinted at the deputy and head-butted him to the ground. Two days later, Deputy Tollackson suffered a stroke and was found unresponsive on the floor of his home due to the severe impact.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
